artworks.title: Porte de l'Avenue Uhrich
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image depicts a perspective from ground level looking across an open space towards distant structures. The horizon aligns with the tops of the buildings in the distance. Various figures are present in the open space, engaged in activities. The drawing is done with delicate lines, resembling etching, showing both architectural and natural elements. The color palette is monochromatic with black and beige tones on a creamy background. Closest to the viewer, there are discarded items and debris scattered haphazardly. On the right, a person stands near a shadowed gate or fence, observing the scene.

artworks.title: Bastion 49
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a bird's-eye view and a wide expanse. The horizon is placed high in the composition, with faint outlines of distant structures and hills visible. Detailed depictions of trees and structures are seen in the foreground, with fields and roads stretching into the distance. A path lined by trees leads into the scene from the left. The image has a monochromatic color palette, highlighting the black lines of the etching against a pale background.

artworks.title: A Guard Post  (Un Poste de garde)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dimly lit interior space with several humanoid forms. The room depicted has an elongated perspective, and shadows dominate the composition. The walls and floorboards are meticulously rendered with fine lines. The right side of the room suggests a collection of thoughts or ideas made visible, while the large dark masses near the center may indicate resting or sleeping shapes. The left edge has a tall structure resembling a window or door, casting light across the room. The artwork's use of shading and cross-hatching creates a deep contrast, emphasizing the room's moody atmosphere.

artworks.title: Vaches sous Bois (Cattle in the Forest)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The etching depicts a scene in a wooded area with cows walking along a path lined with trees. The intricate cross-hatched lines create texture in the leaves, trees, and cows. The color palette contrasts black and white to show depth and light filtering through the foliage. In the distance, a person guides the cows along the path. The shadows under the trees and patches of light are emphasized through dark and light contrasts.

artworks.title: The Cottages
artworks.artist: Maxime Lalanne, after Jan van Goyen
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image portrays a rural scene with a small settlement and fields. The viewpoint appears elevated, showing the horizon high in the composition, directing focus towards the sky with clouds. A tower structure is visible in the distance among trees. Close by on the left are rustic buildings with thatched roofs, partly hidden by trees. The scene displays intricate lines and fine etching details, particularly in the texture of trees and thatching. The color scheme is monochromatic, with various shades of brown and beige. On the right, a few figures are seen in the fields.

artworks.title: Banks of the Meuse
artworks.artist: Maxime Lalanne, after Jan van Goyen
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows a calm waterway with a small group of figures in a boat. In the background, there is a village with a church steeple and sailboats on the water. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing texture in the sky and water. The image is monochromatic, with shades of black and white creating contrast and depth. Large clouds fill the sky, and reflections shimmer in the water below.

artworks.title: Le Pont de Bois
artworks.artist: Maxime Lalanne, after Jacob van Ruisdael
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from above with the horizon low in the frame. The sky has expressive clouds. A path leads into the distance to a small wooden bridge over water. Two horses stand near a rider under large trees casting intricate shadows. The scene uses a monochrome palette of earthy tones to emphasize the contrast between dark vegetation and the lighter sky. Rolling hills blend into the horizon, guiding the viewer's eye through the serene rural scenery.

artworks.title: Le Gué (The Ford)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with cows standing in a body of water. The horizon is above the water, meeting the distant landscape. The sky is filled with large clouds. The brushwork is detailed, creating textures for clouds, water, and foliage. The color palette is black, white, and grey. A wooden structure or boat is in the foreground. In the distance, there are forested trees and a herd of cows wading through the water.

artworks.title: En Forêt (Crépuscule) (In the Forest: Twilight)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image depicts a wooded area, viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The scene is filled with intricate details of tall trees, foliage, and branches overlapping each other. The etching style is detailed with fine lines creating a textured effect. The color palette is monochromatic with varying densities of lines providing contrast between light and dark areas. A deer is visible on the ground, with trees creating a canopy in the background. Wisps of clouds are etched in the sky.

artworks.title: Italian Landscape
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a path leading into the distance. A natural arch formed by a fallen tree or large branch is in the foreground. This arch frames the scene, guiding the eye towards a figure on horseback and a line of smaller figures on a path in the distance, with mountains on the horizon. The etchings show detailed foliage and dense vegetation surrounding the path, characterized by swirling lines. The monochromatic palette includes various shades of beige and dark brown, enhancing texture and details in the image.

artworks.title: Weymouth Bay
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend

artworks.title: Vue d’Hennebont (Morbihan)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The etching depicts a view from a raised perspective overlooking a river flowing from left to right. In the distance, a town with buildings surrounded by trees is visible. Tall trees line a path along the riverbank on the left, with their branches across the upper area of the image. The etching shows detailed lines and cross-hatching to convey texture and depth in the foliage and water. The color scheme is monochromatic, using different shades of black and grey to create contrast and a serene atmosphere. A small boat can be seen drifting on the river in the distance.

artworks.title: Les Ormeaux de Cénon
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image displays a viewpoint at eye-level, looking over a peaceful landscape with a group of tall trees at the center. The horizon sits low in the composition, emphasizing the trees against the sky. The trees stand out with their lush foliage, while the surrounding area shows smaller vegetation leading to the horizon. Delicate brushstrokes create detailed textures across the landscape, including the sky. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones, creating a classic, serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: À Concarneau (Trouville)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image depicts a harbor scene from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon line is positioned almost at the mid-level of the image, lined with buildings and a cluster of dense trees. Beyond the centerpiece is a prominent ship docked at a quay, with other smaller boats visible. To the right, a long wooden staircase leads up from the shore, guiding the eye upwards towards structures that reside on a gentle incline. The artwork is rendered in a detailed etching, with fine, deliberate lines creating texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting solely of shades of black on a cream background. Wispy clouds are etched into the sky, adding movement. Close to us, there are various nautical elements such as barrels and ropes.

artworks.title: À Concarneau (Finistère)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: This image is a finely detailed etching depicting a seaport scene from an aerial viewpoint. The composition includes various activities near us and extends to the water and cityscape in the distance. The horizon is low in the frame with structures and shoreline defining the width of the scene. The etching showcases intricate lines detailing buildings, landscapes, water, and sky with a monochromatic color scheme. Figures and boats are visible along the shoreline, while boats float near a fortified city with towers and spires in the distance.

artworks.title: Grande Rue à Morlaix (Bretagne) (Grand Rue, Morlaix, Brittany)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image displays a narrow street in Morlaix, observed from a slightly elevated angle, facing down the street. Historic buildings with intricate facades and steep roofs line both sides of the street. The horizon is at the end of the road, with faint figures visible in the middle. The artwork features detailed linework to capture the architectural elements and atmosphere. It uses a monochromatic color scheme of grays and blacks to highlight light and shadow contrasts. Additional buildings are seen in the distance, extending the urban scene. Close-up, the street is depicted with sketched lines, adding to the historical depth.

artworks.title: Port de la Plataine à Royan
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor or riverbank with a town in the background. The perspective is slightly elevated. The horizon line is high, with buildings and trees creating a boundary between the sky and town. The etching style has detailed linework and thin brushstrokes. The color palette is black and white. Small boats are in the water, with detailed town architecture beyond. Clouds are visible in the sky.

artworks.title: Ville d’Avray
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description:
The image is viewed from a leveled point of view, with the horizon line placed low, just above the bank of water. On the horizon, a line of trees and houses stretches across the scene. The art is characterized by intricate cross-hatching and fine lines in a monochromatic color palette of black and white. 
 
Close to us, figures are depicted along the bank, some standing, and others seated in the grassy area. In the distance, more structures and foliage blend with the tree line against the sky.

artworks.title: Dans les Champs de Cenon
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from a slightly elevated point. The horizon is low in the image, lined with trees. It is a detailed line drawing, likely an etching, with intricate strokes capturing the foliage and buildings. The color palette is monochrome in shades of sepia or dark brown. Scattered trees and vegetation transition into a grassy field. In the far distance, a village with rooftops and a spire is visible against a lightly cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Le Canal à Pont-Saint-Maxence
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a narrow waterway bordered by lush vegetation. A small boat is docked on the left side near dense foliage. Trees create an arch over the water, the horizon is visible in the distance, and there is a subtle sky above. The painting features delicate brushstrokes, intricate details of foliage and water, and a mainly sepia and black color palette. Two small figures are seen walking along a pathway parallel to the water in the distance.

artworks.title: Un Site Hollandais (A Zaandam)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed scene from a low point of view. Sailboats and windmills are visible in the distance, while the foreground features a waterway with buildings and trees. The etching lines are fine and precise, with intricate detailing in the clouds and vegetation. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white typical of an etching style.

artworks.title: Souvenir de Bordeaux
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a waterway with a wooden boat moored along an embankment. There are several boats anchored in the water, industrial structures on the right, and buildings and ships on the horizon. The artwork is done in fine, detailed brushwork in a monochromatic black and white palette.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for "Un bouquiniste parisien : le père Lécureux"
artworks.medium: etching in blue on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows a large open book on top of closed books, with a piece of paper and dark fabric partially covering them. The color palette is mainly shades of blue. In the background, there is a busy street scene with people, buildings, and trees.

artworks.title: Le Simoun
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carol and James Goodfriend
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape captured from ground level. The horizon is low, emphasizing the sky. Palm trees and traditional thatched-roof structures are visible along the horizon. The image features detailed brushstrokes or etching, with a monochromatic color palette of grey and black. Patches of vegetation and shadows are seen closer to the viewer, while palm trees and huts are in the distance.
